description: Back to careers Product Manager Middelburg or Amsterdam area, Netherlands Full time (or at least 4 days per week) About Maxxton Already familiar with Siblu, Landal, Sandaya or RCN? These organisations all work with Maxxton. Maxxton is the leading property management system provider and reliable SaaS partner for the broader hospitality and accommodation rental sector. Originally a Dutch company, Maxxton has grown into a multinational organisation of 200+ people working in the Netherlands, India, and France — serving holiday parks, campsites, resorts, serviced apartments, and vacation rentals. Our cloud-based platform processes 1,500,000+ reservations a year, supported by a fully integrated suite — including Customer Care, Web Manager, and a broad ecosystem of integrations via our open REST API. We develop leading functionality and act as our customers' strategic partner — in daily dialogue to automate and optimise processes, reduce errors, and save costs. After leading the Dutch market, we are now growing into Europe's market leader. We have big ambitions and ask you to grow with us as our… About The Role The Product Manager's mission is to help our clients achieve their business goals while staying aligned with Maxxton's product strategy. You maximise the value delivered by your team through clear product direction, continuous discovery, and prioritisation decisions that balance client needs, market opportunities, and product quality. This is not a backlog-management role. It is a strategic position that requires commercial awareness, client empathy, and the ability to make defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are actively embedding AI into our way of working and expect you to help shape AI-driven features within your modules, identifying where AI can unlock real value for customers and not just following the hype. What you'll achieve Serving customers and stakeholders Maintain a regular cadence of direct client contact to understand business needs and market trends. Conduct user interviews and research; translate findings into product decisions rather than passing on unfiltered requests. Manage client expectations around timelines, scope, and product direction with transparency. Share quarterly roadmap updates with stakeholders to maintain visibility and alignment. Say 'no' clearly and constructively when needed, with well-reasoned trade-offs. Serving the development team Own a prioritised, well-contextualised backlog with clear outcomes and acceptance criteria for each significant item. Create clarity on what to build and what not to build — and the reasoning behind each call. Participate in design iterations with UX to ensure designs reflect product goals and business context. Partner with the Scrum Master and development team to unblock delivery; you focus on the 'what and why', not on ceremony facilitation. Serving the product organisation Own domain-level OKRs and report progress transparently, including when outcomes are off track. Collaborate with product analysts to monitor product success metrics and KPIs. Keep the Lead PM informed on progress, risks, and cross-domain dependencies — proactively, not reactively. Flag misalignments between client-facing commitments and internal capacity before they become delivery problems. What we're looking for Strategic thinking — you translate company goals and client needs into a coherent direction for your domain. Discovery and customer insight — you identify real problems through interviews, usage data, and client conversations, not assumed ones. Outcome orientation — you track whether shipped features achieve their intended effect and adjust course accordingly. Stakeholder management — you set realistic expectations, communicate trade-offs, and hold firm on scope when appropriate. Decision-making — you make defensible calls under uncertainty, balancing short-term client pressure against long-term product health. Communication — you explain product direction and reasoning clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences. Commercial awareness — you connect product decisions to client outcomes and Maxxton's business goals. Domain affinity — affinity with revenue management, dynamic pricing, or yield optimisation concepts, whether from a product, commercial, or hospitality operations background. Previous experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a software company is essential. Experience in the hospitality or SaaS sector is a plus. How you'll spend your time 40% — discovery, prioritisation, and customer interaction 25% — delivery collaboration (scope clarification, unblocking, design partnership) 20% — stakeholder management and communication 15% — strategy and upward alignment Apply Please send your application, including your CV and motivational letter, to career@maxxton.com . For more information, contact Ramon van Loon (HR Manager) at +31 (0)118 671010.

description: About The Role redBus is India's largest online bus ticketing platform, moving millions of travellers across 150,000+ live routes globally. A meaningful share of our growth now comes from platforms we don't fully control ourselves — B2B2C seller tools, partner APIs, whitelabels, OTAs, and super-app integrations — where product decisions are inseparable from technical architecture decisions. We are looking for a Technical Product Lead who is equally comfortable writing a crisp PRD and reading an API contract or a data pipeline diagram. This role sits at the intersection of classic product management — roadmaps, prioritisation, stakeholder alignment — and the deeper technical fluency needed to partner credibly with engineering on system design, integrations, and platform scalability. You'll own both the “low-hanging” product requirements that keep the roadmap moving and the harder technical trade-offs that determine whether it scales. Key Responsibilities Product Roadmap Ownership – Define, prioritise, and execute the product roadmap for partner-facing and distribution platforms, balancing quick-win requirements against longer-horizon technical investments. Technical Depth in Product Decisions – Partner directly with engineering on API design, data flow pipelines, and system architecture; be able to evaluate technical trade-offs (latency, scalability, integration complexity) rather than relying solely on engineering estimates. Requirement Documentation – Write PRDs, user stories, API specifications, and wireframes; define clear acceptance criteria and success metrics for every release. Cross-Functional & Partner Collaboration – Work across engineering, design, sales, partner/BD, CRM, payments, and supplier-facing teams to align the roadmap within the broader product framework. – Engage directly with external partners (OTAs, travel platforms, super apps, and aggregators) to curate integration requirements and merchandising offerings. Data-Driven Iteration – Run and analyse A/B tests across web, mobile web, and apps; build dashboards and hypotheses using SQL and product analytics tools to guide decisions. – Continuously monitor product and platform performance metrics, using them to prioritise the backlog. Quality, Launch & Enablement – Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA to ensure releases meet both business and technical bars before going live. – Train internal stakeholders (Support, Channel, Field teams) on new features to ensure smooth rollouts. What You Bring 1–3 years of experience spanning both software engineering/development and product management — candidates from a strong technical background moving into product, or PMs with genuine hands-on engineering experience, are equally welcome. Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech); an MBA is a plus but not a substitute for technical depth. Working knowledge of APIs, system design fundamentals, and data pipelines — enough to have a substantive technical conversation with engineering, not just consume their output. Proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with web/app analytics and experimentation tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, or similar). Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum practices — backlog grooming, sprint planning, and PDLC end to end. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints into business language and vice versa. Business acumen to understand how distribution, partnerships, and platform decisions tie back to revenue and growth. Why This Role This is a role for someone who doesn't want to choose between being a “product person” and a “technical person.” You'll own real product outcomes — roadmaps, launches, partner relationships — while staying close enough to the architecture to make the calls that matter. If you're energised by both the business “why” and the engineering “how,” we'd love to talk.
title: Associate Product Manager

description: About Us: Tech Mahindra offers technology consulting and digital solutions to global enterprises across industries, enabling transformative scale at unparalleled speed. With 149k+ professionals across 90+ countries helping 1100+ clients, TechM provides a full spectrum of services including consulting, information technology, enterprise applications, business process services, engineering services, network services, customer experience & design services, AI & analytics, and cloud & infrastructure services. It is the first Indian company in the world to have been awarded the Sustainable Markets Initiative’s Terra Carta Seal, in recognition of actively leading the charge to create a climate and nature-positive future. Tech Mahindra (NSE: TECHM) is part of the Mahindra Group, founded in 1945, one of the largest and most admired multinational federations of companies. Job Details Experience: 10 to 15 years Job Type: Full-time & Hybrid Domain : Telecom Salary Range: 80K€ to 100K€ per annum Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Business Consultant with a strong background in Business Analysis, specifically within the TV and Media domain in the Telecom industry. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of business processes and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who can collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that meet business objectives. Key responsibilities: Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to TV and Media solutions in the Telecom sector. Develop and maintain architectural designs and solution blueprints that align with business needs and technical capabilities. Lead the design and implementation of solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and meet performance standards. Collaborate with development teams to ensure that solutions are built according to specifications and best practices. Conduct feasibility studies and impact assessments to evaluate potential solutions and their alignment with business goals. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members in business analysis and solution architecture. Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to recommend innovative solutions. Facilitate workshops and meetings with stakeholders to drive consensus and ensure alignment on project objectives. Mandatory Skills: Proven experience in Business Analysis, with a strong understanding of business processes and requirements gathering. Extensive knowledge of the TV and Media domain, particularly within the Telecom industry. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and strategically. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders at all levels. Experience in creating architectural designs and solution blueprints. Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools. Preferred Skills: Experience with Agile methodologies and frameworks. Familiarity with cloud technologies and platforms. Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools. Experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. 10-15 years of experience in Business Analysis and Solution Architecture, with a focus on the Telecom industry. Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Solution Architecture, or Project Management are a plus. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for delivering innovative solutions in the TV and Media domain, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. How To Apply: It's easy to apply online; you just need a copy of your up-to-date CV and to follow the step-by step process. Don't worry if you need to make changes - you'll have the opportunity to review and edit your work on the final page, or you can also share resume directly to provided email address. We look forward to receiving your application! Tech Mahindra is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We promote and support a diverse workforce at all levels of the company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin or disability. All applicants will be evaluated solely on the basis of their ability, competence, and performance of the essential functions of their positions.
